job.exclusions: No unrelated jobs or career evidence by default.

job-prep.exclusions: No other jobs or unverified career claims. Fails if the canonical evidence bank is unavailable.

cv-evidence.exclusions: No CV drafting or placeholder CVs. Fails if canonical sources are unavailable.

idea.exclusions: No job history; do not implement the idea automatically.

project.exclusions: Follow named links only on request; no recursive import.

session.exclusions: No chat history; load the referenced entity only via a second explicit command.

planning.exclusions: No all-vault scan; request a category index explicitly if needed.
